title: The Village
caption: The last village at the plateau's edge.

time.means: which years the village is in: prologue — the prologue and the first chapter (the dying village: empty houses, roofs fallen in, the charcoal heaps, the stream's bed dry, the slope bare); chapter2 — six years on (empty; the stream running, Lina's garden by it, her father's fresh grave, a grey haze of young oaks on the slope); chapter3 — twenty years on (a few houses mended, gardens, fruit trees, the forest grown over the village); epilogue — thirty years on (every house roofed anew, flowers on the sills, the fountain clean, the forest)

dawn.means: the dawn light (2.1): 0 the day's, 1 just before sunrise — rose and gold low, the sun coming up behind the viewer's left

edge.means: the forest's lower edge over the village (from chapter3): whole; stumps — cut for charcoal, a band of fresh stumps (the Silence line, 3.5); regrown — ten years on, man-high young oaks among grey stumps (the epilogue on the Silence line)

edge_house.means: in chapter3, the empty house at the edge: lived — the Traveller lives in it (the Slope line): its roof mended, glazed (its chimney: smoke_edge)

stump.means: the middle of the square: the lime's stump; dug — the stump gone, a pit, the earth heaped, a young lime lying ready (Э.1); planted — the young lime standing, tied to its stake

mug.means: Lina's tin mug set upside down on the stump (П.2)

wet.means: water just poured: the stump's face and a run down its bark dark (П.2, 1.7), or the earth round the planted lime

cart.means: the charcoal burner's handcart by his house, heaped with sacks (1.7)

rod.means: Elzéard's iron rod leaning against the fountain's trough (the last shot of «Рассказ»)

home_door.means: the door of Lina's father's house: 180 shut, 95 wide open into the dark house (it slams: moved to 180 fast)

coal.means: the charcoal heaps' smoke: 0 none, 1 both smouldering (the prologue)

fountain.means: the fountain running: 0 dry, 1 the jet and the brimming trough (the epilogue)

smoke_home.means: smoke from the chimney of lina's father's house: 0 cold, 1 a hearth lit

smoke_edge.means: smoke from the chimney of the empty house at the village's edge: 0 cold, 1 a hearth lit

smoke_b1.means: smoke from the chimney of a house at the back of the square: 0 cold, 1 a hearth lit

smoke_b2.means: smoke from the chimney of a ruined house at the back: 0 cold, 1 a hearth lit

smoke_l2.means: smoke from the chimney of a house on the left: 0 cold, 1 a hearth lit

smoke_r1.means: smoke from the chimney of a house on the right: 0 cold, 1 a hearth lit

prompts.text: Solo nylon-string guitar, slow sparse fingerpicking, long silences between phrases, warm and wistful
Soft wooden flute over a low drone, open fifths, a lonely high plateau at dusk
Quiet felt piano, few notes, lots of air, like wind over dry grass
Ambient pads of distant wind, barely moving, golden evening light
Pastoral folk waltz on accordion and violin, gentle and old-fashioned
Cello and harp duet, slow and tender, a sense of patience
Minimalist marimba patterns, slowly growing, like seedlings
Shepherd's pipe melody, modal, unaccompanied, echoing across hills
String quartet, sustained hopeful chords, slow build
Music box lullaby, simple and fragile, slightly out of tune
Warm clarinet over soft strings, nostalgic, unhurried
Hammered dulcimer, gentle repeating figure, morning mist
Low bowed double bass and wind, sparse and dry, a dead land
Choir humming softly in the distance, no words, reverent
Mandolin tremolo, quiet and bittersweet, a village at evening
Glassy electric piano with tape warmth, calm and spacious
Solo violin, plain slow melody, the bow almost whispering
Birdsong-like woodwinds over a gentle string bed, a forest waking
Running water and a soft celesta, a stream heard for the first time, quiet wonder
